scientific_target.name: first_survey_recorded_detection_from_known_2003_founders
scientific_target.evaluation_sites: the 47 archived repeatedly surveyed sites in the source-code-declared row order
scientific_target.positive: at least one archived detection in a surveyed site-year, provided no earlier archived detection exists for that site
scientific_target.negative: at least one archived visit and no detection in that site-year, provided no earlier archived detection exists
scientific_target.missing: all visits missing/not surveyed; excluded rather than recoded
scientific_target.unavailable: source-code-declared destroyed site-years; excluded rather than recoded
scientific_target.claim_boundary: survey-recorded first detection conditional on the declared founders and archived monitoring; not latent biological colonization probability or actual route reconstruction

time_contract.rule_state_update_in_holdout: allowed only after each heldout year's first-detection outcomes occur; model coefficients remain calibration-frozen

layer_a_worlds.sigma_interpretation: response-blind analyst-choice full-tail scale equal to the frozen LCC90 threshold; not an estimated frog dispersal parameter

rules.edge_rule: all distinct wetland pairs receive Gaussian raw support

layer_a_worlds.compatibility_update: A surviving rule is eliminated when a calibration/previously observed heldout first-detection target has cumulative first-passage support <= 1e-15 by its declared horizon from the fixed founders.
layer_a_worlds.monotonicity: surviving rule identities may remain or contract and are never recreated
layer_a_worlds.finite_universe_falsification: if all five rules are eliminated, preserve universe_falsified and stop predictive scoring without retuning

site_features: log1p Euclidean distance to nearest founder
survey_features: number of non-missing visits in the target site-year
mean air temperature across non-missing visits
shared_non_eog_features.missing_covariate_rule: candidate row requires finite survey covariates for at least one archived visit; calibration medians may fill remaining within-row missing non-response visit covariates only
shared_non_eog_features.standardization: calibration mean/SD only; zero-SD columns dropped without heldout inspection

eog_summary_logistic.features: shared non-EOG features plus the ten frozen Layer-B features

same_world_mean_only_logistic.features: shared non-EOG features plus support_mean and surviving_world_fraction only
same_world_mean_only_logistic.purpose: test whether the frozen distributional Layer-B summary adds information beyond a scalar compression of the same worlds
same_world_mean_only_logistic.type: L2 logistic regression with the same fitting policy

founder_connectivity_logistic.features: shared non-EOG features plus full-tail Gaussian founder connectivity
founder_connectivity_logistic.type: L2 logistic regression with the same fitting policy

dynamic_occupancy_hmm.fitting: maximum-likelihood two-state hidden Markov occupancy model on calibration years only; heldout coefficients frozen and latent filtering updated sequentially after observations

features: distance to each of the three founders
founder counts within each four frozen structural thresholds

response_estimability.layer_b_estimability: at least one frozen Layer-B feature must contain calibration variation beyond the shared baseline; otherwise report layer_b_non_estimable

secondary_metrics: ROC AUC when both classes exist
layer_b_favorable_if_all: EOG summary lower log loss than mean-only in at least 4 of 5 heldout years
external_added_value_favorable_if_all: EOG summary macro-year log loss lower than founder-connectivity logistic, dynamic occupancy HMM and flexible random forest
EOG summary lower than the best external comparator in at least 4 of 5 heldout years
metrics_and_decisions.otherwise: preserve no_confirmed_added_value, adverse, non_estimable or universe_falsified without retuning
metrics_and_decisions.dependence_boundary: heldout years are the outer reporting units; wetland-year rows do not create independent years and no bootstrap is used to manufacture temporal replication

no_retuning_after_response: world thresholds, kernel, sigma or support tolerance
